Product Story

Made to be Noticed.

Every detail of VELORA is engineered for the senses — from the weight of the bar in your hand to the way it breaks.

Premium Cocoa

Single-origin beans sourced from micro-farms, fermented and roasted for maximum depth of flavor.

Handcrafted

Small-batch tempering by master chocolatiers ensures every bar has a consistent, glass-like snap.

Rich Texture

A slow-conched process creates an exceptionally silky mouthfeel with a lingering, complex finish.

Sustainable Packaging

Compostable wrappers and FSC-certified paper, designed with the same care as what's inside.

Ingredients

Nothing Hidden. Nothing Wasted.

We disclose every component of our recipe — because transparency is a form of respect.

Criollo Cacao MassVenezuela
Raw Cane SugarMauritius
Cocoa ButterEcuador
Madagascar VanillaMadagascar
Sea Salt FlakesBrittany, France
Craftsmanship

The Art Behind the Bar.

From bean to bar, every stage is deliberate — a process refined over a decade of obsession.

01

Selective Sourcing

We work directly with a handful of family farms, paying above market rate for beans harvested at peak ripeness.

02

Slow Conching

Each batch is conched for 72 hours at controlled temperatures, developing aroma without bitterness.

03

Precision Tempering

Hand-tempered in small batches to achieve the signature VELORA snap and mirror-glossed finish.
